messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High IO wait and p99 latency observed on inference-runtime.continuous-batcher. alert_id=CB-2026-03-13-02 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: service=inference-runtime.continuous-batcher region=eu-west-1 symptom=p99>=2500ms for 4m, io_wait spike, pod_ooms=3. alert link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/cont-batch/eu-west1

lina.ops: spotted it on dashboard. p95 ~480ms -> 1.6s, p99 above 3s. disk IO spiking on nodes hosting cont-batcher. KV cache bytes per pod climbing steadily.

omar.engineer: curious if a config rollout happened. anyone touch cont-batcher config in last 15m?

deploy-bot: CONFIG CHANGE detected: cont-batcher-config@v2026-03-13T09:02Z by nina_platform. Diff: max_num_seqs: 4 -> 12, max_batch_tokens: 1024 -> 3072, request_timeout_ms: 500 -> 2000

sre_lead_kate: increasing both num_seqs and batch_tokens and lengthening timeout is dangerous. it can hold KV slices open longer and balloon memory/cache.

lina.ops: logs show repeated page-to-disk churn and long-lived batch holders:
```
I0313 09:18:11.002 batch_owner.cpp:137] hold_batch(seq=0,id=321) duration_ms=2100
W0313 09:18:11.045 kv_cache.cpp:312] KVCache::reserve failed: insufficient contiguous region, current_bytes=254MB, required=512MB
E0313 09:18:11.046 mem_monitor.cpp:89] OOM event triggered, killing worker pid=45
```

omar.engineer: hypothesis: longer request timeout allows partial batches to wait, so many batches accumulate, each reserving KV ranges; eviction can't keep up -> OS swap/paging -> IO waits -> latency cliff and pod OOMs.

sre_lead_kate: mitigation plan: 1) rollback config to previous stable values 2) restart worst pods 3) temporarily tighten request_timeout_ms to 300ms and max_num_seqs=6 4) increase replica count by 2 while stabilizing

lina.ops: rolling back now. patching cm and restarting deployment. `kubectl apply -f cont-batcher-config-rollback.yaml -n inference`

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK APPLIED cont-batcher-config@v2026-03-13T09:27Z by lina.ops :white_check_mark:

omar.engineer: restarting pods with highest restart counts: `kubectl delete pod cont-batcher-5c7d -n inference` then wait for scheduler to recreate.

lina.ops: scaled replicas 4 -> 7 for temporary headroom.

cs_erin: any customer notices? I have a ticket from a customer on long-dialog beta reporting timeouts ~5m ago. ticket=#CS-8891

lina.ops: yes, we see 5xx spikes for clients using long-dialog. marking impacted_customers in incident ticket INC-2026-0428: TA-99, TA-210, TA-402.

omar.engineer: metrics after rollback: kv_cache_total_bytes fell from ~95GB -> ~22GB across cont-batcher pods over 6m. p95 back to ~180ms, p99 down to ~420ms, io_wait normalized. some pods still restarting less frequently.

sre_lead_kate: good. keep Handoff: lina -> omar. Lina you can go to 1:1, Omar keep primary until next rotation.

lina.ops: handing to omar, leaving watch notes in the incident ticket. added runbook step: if request_timeout_ms > 1000ms block in pipeline.

omar.engineer: investigating root cause chain: deploy pipeline allowed unconstrained increases to batch sizing without KV budget check. will add a preflight check to the pipeline that estimates worst-case KV bytes per pod for proposed values.

cs_erin: sending customer update: "We experienced a runtime regression affecting long-dialog workloads due to a configuration change that increased batch sizing and request timeouts. We reverted the config and scaled capacity; service performance has been restored. Support will follow up with affected accounts." will attach metrics and ETA for postmortem.

sre_lead_kate: creating followups: 1) INC-2026-0428 postmortem ticket + timeline 2) pipeline guardrail PR (owner: nina_platform) 3) KV cache absolute bytes alert at pod level (owner: omar.engineer) 4) add canary gate that runs a small synthetic long-dialog load test on config changes

nina_platform: ack, will open PR to block request_timeout_ms > 1000 and max_num_seqs > 8 for prod by default.

omar.engineer: one odd observation: a compaction job on pod cont-batcher-2b3f kept thrashing disk even after rollback; killed the job and pod settled. adding a followup to tune compaction backoff.

lina.ops: current status: mitigated=true, p95=160ms, p99=380ms, kv_cache_total=20GB. will keep thread open for 3h observation window.

sre_lead_kate: set severity to P2 for now, will close to P3 if no recurrence in 24h.

cs_erin: customer comms sent, will reopen if customers reply.

nina_platform: patching pipeline now to add cheap preflight. planning PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/824

omar.engineer: logging incident learnings in the runbook: "guard reserved KV bytes per sequence and cap request timeouts on cont-batcher config pushes."

lina.ops: thanks everyone. handing back to rotation.

sre_lead_kate: acknowledged. great fast ops. :thumbsup:
